# freeipa_sysaccount (Data Source)

FreeIPA System Account data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) User ID of the system account

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description
- `disabled` (Boolean) Is the system account locked
- `id` (String) ID of the resource in the terraform state
- `memberof_role` (List of String) List of roles this system account is member of.
